newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO SALVAGE DRAW WITH TWO LATE GOALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO SALVAGE DRAW WITH TWO LATE GOALS.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna were saved from a disastrous fourth round Spanish Cup defeat by two late goals in the 2-2 draw at home to Espanyol on Tuesday.
Beleaguered coach John Toshack had seen his side go behind to strikes by Miguel Angel Benitez and Florin Raducioiu.
But Maikel and Rivaldo capitalised on the nervousness of Espanyol reserve goalkeeper Raul Arrivas.
Deportivo have lost their way in the league over the past few weeks and an early exit from the Cup they won in 1995 would inevitably increase the pressure on Toshack.
